summary: Insurance policy for commercial entities under Consumer Protection Act, 1986; definition of 'consumer' excluding commercial purpose; indemnity vs profit motive; National Commission's interpretation overturned; commercial disputes under Commercial Courts Act, 2015; insurance not for profit generation but risk coverage; maintainability of complaint dismissed for large-scale businesses.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; National Commission's judgment set aside; complaint not maintainable under Consumer Protection Act, 1986.
